sentences.pt: Rodrigo trabalha em um escritório no centro de São Paulo e passa oito horas por dia sentado, usando o computador.
sentences.en: Rodrigo works in an office in downtown São Paulo and spends eight hours a day sitting down, using the computer.

sentences.pt: Há algumas semanas, ele começou a sentir uma dor forte nas costas.
sentences.en: A few weeks ago, he started to feel a strong pain in his back.

sentences.pt: No começo, achou que a dor ia passar sozinha.
sentences.en: At first, he thought the pain would go away by itself.

sentences.pt: Tomou alguns comprimidos e continuou trabalhando como sempre.
sentences.en: He took some pills and kept working as usual.

sentences.pt: No entanto, a dor piorou, e um dia ele mal conseguiu levantar da cama.
sentences.en: However, the pain got worse, and one day he could barely get out of bed.

sentences.pt: A esposa dele, Fernanda, ficou preocupada.
sentences.en: His wife, Fernanda, got worried.

sentences.pt: — Você precisa ir ao médico. É importante que você cuide da sua saúde.
sentences.en: "You need to go to the doctor. It's important that you take care of your health."

sentences.pt: Rodrigo agendou uma consulta para quinta-feira.
sentences.en: Rodrigo booked an appointment for Thursday.

sentences.pt: A médica fez muitas perguntas e pediu alguns exames.
sentences.en: The doctor asked many questions and ordered some tests.

sentences.pt: Depois dos exames, ela explicou o diagnóstico.
sentences.en: After the tests, she explained the diagnosis.

sentences.pt: — Os seus ossos estão bem, mas os músculos das costas estão muito fracos.
sentences.en: "Your bones are fine, but your back muscles are very weak."

sentences.pt: — O senhor fica sentado o dia inteiro e quase não faz exercício.
sentences.en: "You sit the whole day and hardly exercise."

sentences.pt: Ela disse que ele deveria andar pelo menos trinta minutos por dia.
sentences.en: She said he should walk at least thirty minutes a day.

sentences.pt: Também explicou que ele precisava levantar da cadeira de hora em hora.
sentences.en: She also explained that he needed to get up from his chair every hour.

sentences.pt: Rodrigo voltou para casa um pouco decepcionado, porque esperava um remédio mais fácil.
sentences.en: Rodrigo went back home a little disappointed, because he was hoping for an easier remedy.

sentences.pt: Mesmo assim, decidiu seguir o tratamento.
sentences.en: Even so, he decided to follow the treatment.

sentences.pt: Nas primeiras semanas, foi difícil.
sentences.en: In the first weeks, it was hard.

sentences.pt: Ele estava sempre cansado e às vezes esquecia de levantar da cadeira.
sentences.en: He was always tired and sometimes forgot to get up from his chair.

sentences.pt: Então Fernanda passou a mandar uma mensagem para ele a cada hora.
sentences.en: So Fernanda started sending him a message every hour.

sentences.pt: Aos poucos, os músculos ficaram mais fortes e a dor diminuiu.
sentences.en: Little by little, the muscles got stronger and the pain went down.

sentences.pt: Depois de dois meses, Rodrigo já andava cinco quilômetros todos os dias.
sentences.en: After two months, Rodrigo was already walking five kilometers every day.

sentences.pt: Ele até perdeu quatro quilos e passou a dormir melhor.
sentences.en: He even lost four kilos and started sleeping better.

sentences.pt: Na última consulta, a médica ficou satisfeita com o desempenho dele.
sentences.en: At the last appointment, the doctor was pleased with his progress.

sentences.pt: — Espero que o senhor continue com os exercícios.
sentences.en: "I hope you keep up the exercises."

sentences.pt: Rodrigo respondeu que agora não conseguia mais ficar sem andar.
sentences.en: Rodrigo answered that now he couldn't go without walking anymore.

sentences.pt: Afinal, tinha aprendido que precisava cuidar do corpo todos os dias.
sentences.en: After all, he had learned that he needed to take care of his body every day.

questions.q: O que a médica disse sobre os músculos dele?
questions.qEn: What did the doctor say about his muscles?

sentences.pt: Camila ia viajar para Salvador com duas amigas no sábado.
sentences.en: Camila was going to travel to Salvador with two friends on Saturday.

sentences.pt: Elas tinham comprado as passagens três meses antes.
sentences.en: They had bought the tickets three months before.

sentences.pt: Na quarta-feira, porém, Camila acordou com dor de garganta e uma tosse forte.
sentences.en: On Wednesday, however, Camila woke up with a sore throat and a bad cough.

sentences.pt: À tarde, ela começou a sentir frio, apesar do calor que fazia em Recife, onde morava.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, she started to feel cold, despite the heat in Recife, where she lived.

sentences.pt: Mediu a temperatura e viu que estava com 39 graus de febre.
sentences.en: She took her temperature and saw that she had a fever of 39 degrees.

sentences.pt: — Acho que é só um resfriado — disse para a mãe pelo telefone.
sentences.en: "I think it's just a cold," she told her mother on the phone.

sentences.pt: A mãe, Dona Lúcia, não concordou.
sentences.en: Her mother, Dona Lúcia, didn't agree.

sentences.pt: — Talvez seja gripe, filha. É melhor que você vá ao médico hoje mesmo.
sentences.en: "Maybe it's the flu, dear. You'd better go to the doctor today."

sentences.pt: Camila foi ao hospital do bairro naquela tarde.
sentences.en: Camila went to the neighborhood hospital that afternoon.

sentences.pt: O médico ouviu a respiração dela e olhou a garganta.
sentences.en: The doctor listened to her breathing and looked at her throat.

sentences.pt: — É gripe, sim. A senhora precisa ficar em casa e descansar pelo menos cinco dias.
sentences.en: "It is the flu. You need to stay home and rest for at least five days."

sentences.pt: Camila ficou chateada e disse que ia viajar no sábado.
sentences.en: Camila got upset and said she was going to travel on Saturday.

sentences.pt: — Com febre, a viagem não vai ser divertida, e a senhora pode passar a gripe para as suas amigas.
sentences.en: "With a fever, the trip won't be fun, and you could give the flu to your friends."

sentences.pt: Ele deu uma receita de remédios para a febre e para a tosse.
sentences.en: He gave her a prescription for medicine for the fever and the cough.

sentences.pt: Na farmácia, Camila comprou os remédios e voltou para casa.
sentences.en: At the pharmacy, Camila bought the medicine and went back home.

sentences.pt: Depois, ligou para as amigas, Júlia e Mariana, e contou tudo.
sentences.en: Then she called her friends, Júlia and Mariana, and told them everything.

sentences.pt: Elas entenderam e disseram que também iam adiar a viagem.
sentences.en: They understood and said they would also postpone the trip.

sentences.pt: — A gente não quer ir sem você — disse Júlia.
sentences.en: "We don't want to go without you," said Júlia.

sentences.pt: Durante cinco dias, Camila dormiu muito, bebeu muita água e tomou sopa.
sentences.en: For five days, Camila slept a lot, drank a lot of water and had soup.

sentences.pt: A mãe vinha todos os dias e trazia caldo de frango feito em casa.
sentences.en: Her mother came every day and brought homemade chicken broth.

sentences.pt: No começo, Camila se sentia triste e entediada.
sentences.en: At first, Camila felt sad and bored.

sentences.pt: Aos poucos, porém, a febre passou e a tosse diminuiu.
sentences.en: Little by little, however, the fever went away and the cough eased.

sentences.pt: Uma semana depois, ela já se sentia bem melhor.
sentences.en: A week later, she already felt much better.

sentences.pt: As três amigas trocaram as passagens para o mês que vem.
sentences.en: The three friends changed the tickets to next month.

sentences.pt: Elas pagaram uma pequena multa, mas ninguém reclamou.
sentences.en: They paid a small fee, but nobody complained.

sentences.pt: Camila aprendeu que a saúde deve vir em primeiro lugar.
sentences.en: Camila learned that health must come first.

sentences.pt: Agora ela já agendou a vacina contra a gripe para o próximo inverno.
sentences.en: Now she has already booked her flu vaccine for next winter.

questions.q: Qual era a temperatura de Camila?
O que o médico disse para Camila?
questions.qEn: What did the doctor tell Camila?
